checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Woman in community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward camera
must.why: Smiling woman in green apron among raised beds, turning from side to face the camera.

must.item: Lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', no extra text
must.why: Both lines are spelled correctly in frames 2 and 3, and no other text appears.

must.item: Legible white lettering on dark backing at bottom left, no clipping
must.why: White bold text on a dark translucent box at bottom left, fully visible.

must.item: Lower third stays off her face and stays stable and readable
must.why: It stays off her face, but it disappears by 6.9 s, so it is not stable through the clip.

must.item: Caption absent in first second, present from ~1 s through end
must.why: Absent at 0.7 s and present at 2.9 and 5.1 s, but gone at 6.9 s, before the end.
16:9 and about 7 s, but the audio analysis reports sound (peak -33.8 dB), so it is not silent.

faults.what: Caption is gone in the final frame (6.9 s), but it was meant to stay until the end.
The clip has an audio track with sound, although the user asked for a silent clip. The assistant also claimed there was no audio.
Motion is small. She turns only slightly, and the caption box is a semi-transparent AI-drawn overlay.

summary: The garden scene is good and the caption text is spelled correctly, but the caption vanishes before the end and the clip has an audio track when it should be silent.
